name: 16 Cyber-Personalities: Survivors
detailed_description:
Do you believe that tiny creatures dwell in the recesses of your mind? 

Inspired by MBTI, in 16 Cyber-Personalities: Survivors, you'll discover that your inner world is teeming with spirited beings—quirky, endearing, and ready for battle. Come get to know these charming spirits and bond with them as you stand together against the creeping shadows of doubt and fear.

Embark on an extraordinary journey where every personality unveils its hidden strengths. As you command your elemental sprites—each reflecting a distinct MBTI personality trait—watch them evolve through unique upgrade branches, transforming into formidable allies. Every encounter becomes a chance to learn more about who you truly are, as you craft dynamic builds that mirror your inner complexity.

So, what is your gaming MBTI? Step into the arena of your mind, forge powerful bonds, and let the adventure reveal the depths of your personality.


Key Features

  • Personalized Elemental Sprites: Use elemental sprites to embody your personality; each sprite not only reflects its unique individuality but also comes with exclusive skill upgrade branches, offering you a myriad of strategic options.

  • 16 Unique MBTI Skills: Every MBTI personality boasts its one-of-a-kind skill, each of which can evolve further through upgrade branches to create your own distinctive battle style.

  • Fast-Paced Short Runs: Each run lasts around 15 minutes, featuring meticulously designed, short battles that deliver an exhilarating gameplay experience in a compact timeframe.

  • Hundreds of Traits and Items: Choose from hundreds of traits and items to enjoy fresh experiences and new combinations every run, ensuring each playthrough is full of surprises.

  • Innovative Theme Integration: Experience a unique fusion of personality testing and game mechanics, where exploring your inner world is paired with adventure-filled, strategic combat.

short_description: Inspired by MBTI, this is a fast-paced, top-down arena shooter roguelite where your inner world becomes the battleground. Harness the power of four elemental sprites to fend off the sinister forces lurking in your mind. No matter what your personalities are, you can conquer your darkest thoughts!
